```{python}
#| echo: false

"""
Compute the per-year RDM and TAC impact of existing-customer enrollment
in Rate HP on non-residential classes.

Only *existing* HP customers (switching from Rate 1 to Rate HP with
unchanged kWh) create an under-collection.  New HP customers create an
over-collection.  This notebook quantifies the non-residential share
of the existing-customer under-collection under the Company's
company-wide RDM and TAC reconciliation mechanisms.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import pickle
from pathlib import Path

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load caches
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
c1_raw = pickle.loads(Path("../cache/ciec_1_vars.pkl").read_bytes())
c13_raw = pickle.loads(Path("../cache/ciec_13_vars.pkl").read_bytes())

# Per-customer revenue decrease when an existing HP customer moves
# from Rate 1 to Rate HP (same kWh, lower winter rate).
dec_dist: float = c1_raw["dec_dist"]
dec_tx: float = c1_raw["dec_tx"]
dec_total: float = dec_dist + dec_tx

# Per-customer T&D revenue increase when a new HP customer enrolls in
# Rate HP at install time (more kWh overwhelms lower rate).
# From the overpayment notebook: the mean T&D bill delta per new HP customer.
mean_bill_delta_new: float = c13_raw["mean_bill_delta"]

# Enrollment counts.
existing_customers: int = int(c1_raw["existing_customers"])
YEARS: list[int] = c1_raw["years"]
floor_enrolled: list = c1_raw["floor_enrolled"]
ceiling_enrolled: list = c1_raw["ceiling_enrolled"]

# Rate Year billed sales (MWh) — the RDM denominator.
# From Exhibit CLP-RATES-2 at 3 (CLP-RATES-2.1).
RATE1_MWH = 8_716_958.14
RATE5_MWH = 1_593_008.20
RATE7_MWH = 9_126.89
RDM_TOTAL_MWH = 20_457_507
residential_mwh = RATE1_MWH + RATE5_MWH + RATE7_MWH
nonres_kwh_share = 1 - residential_mwh / RDM_TOTAL_MWH
nonres_mwh = RDM_TOTAL_MWH - residential_mwh

# TAC allocation: demand at the Company's 12 monthly system peaks.
# From Docket 26-01-03, CL&P Rates Filing, Attachment 1, Exhibit 4 at 4.
TAC_TOTAL_KW = 3_785_696.4
TAC_RES_KW = 1_652_552.5 + 338_287.6  # Rates 1+7, Rate 5
nonres_demand_share = 1 - TAC_RES_KW / TAC_TOTAL_KW

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Per-year impact: existing-customer shortfall on non-residential classes
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Under auto-enrollment, all existing HP customers enroll in Year 1.
# The shortfall is the same every year (no new existing customers after that).

# Distribution: RDM leak to non-residential classes.
annual_dist_shortfall = existing_customers * dec_dist
nonres_dist_shortfall = annual_dist_shortfall * nonres_kwh_share
rdm_impact_per_kwh = annual_dist_shortfall / (RDM_TOTAL_MWH * 1000)

# Transmission: TAC leak to non-residential classes.
annual_tx_shortfall = existing_customers * dec_tx
nonres_tx_shortfall = annual_tx_shortfall * nonres_demand_share

# Total.
annual_total_shortfall = annual_dist_shortfall + annual_tx_shortfall
nonres_total_shortfall = nonres_dist_shortfall + nonres_tx_shortfall

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build year-by-year table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
rows = []
for i, year in enumerate(YEARS):
    n_existing = existing_customers

    n_new_floor = int(floor_enrolled[i + 1][1]) - existing_customers
    n_new_ceiling = int(ceiling_enrolled[i + 1][1]) - existing_customers

    # Distribution shortfall from existing (same every year).
    dist_short = n_existing * dec_dist
    tx_short = n_existing * dec_tx

    # Non-residential share of existing-customer shortfall.
    nonres_dist = dist_short * nonres_kwh_share
    nonres_tx = tx_short * nonres_demand_share

    # RDM per-kWh impact from existing-customer shortfall.
    rdm_cents = dist_short / (RDM_TOTAL_MWH * 1000) * 100

    # New-customer over-collection (for context).
    new_over_floor = n_new_floor * mean_bill_delta_new
    new_over_ceiling = n_new_ceiling * mean_bill_delta_new

    rows.append({
        "year": year,
        "existing_customers": n_existing,
        "new_customers_floor": n_new_floor,
        "new_customers_ceiling": n_new_ceiling,
        "dist_shortfall": dist_short,
        "tx_shortfall": tx_short,
        "total_shortfall": dist_short + tx_short,
        "nonres_dist_shortfall": nonres_dist,
        "nonres_tx_shortfall": nonres_tx,
        "nonres_total_shortfall": nonres_dist + nonres_tx,
        "rdm_cents_per_kwh": rdm_cents,
        "new_over_floor": new_over_floor,
        "new_over_ceiling": new_over_ceiling,
    })

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export report variables
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
report_vars: dict = {
    "existing_customers": existing_customers,
    "dec_dist": dec_dist,
    "dec_tx": dec_tx,
    "dec_total": dec_total,
    "mean_bill_delta_new": mean_bill_delta_new,
    "annual_dist_shortfall": annual_dist_shortfall,
    "annual_tx_shortfall": annual_tx_shortfall,
    "annual_total_shortfall": annual_total_shortfall,
    "nonres_dist_shortfall": nonres_dist_shortfall,
    "nonres_tx_shortfall": nonres_tx_shortfall,
    "nonres_total_shortfall": nonres_total_shortfall,
    "nonres_kwh_share": nonres_kwh_share,
    "nonres_demand_share": nonres_demand_share,
    "rdm_impact_per_kwh": rdm_impact_per_kwh,
    "rdm_impact_cents_per_kwh": rdm_impact_per_kwh * 100,
    "rdm_total_mwh": RDM_TOTAL_MWH,
    "years": YEARS,
    "rows": rows,
}

Path("../cache/ciec_2d_vars.pkl").write_bytes(pickle.dumps(report_vars))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build and upload Excel workbook
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
from build_ciec_2d_workbook import (
    DRIVE_FOLDER_ID,
    DRIVE_NAME,
    Inputs,
    build_workbook,
    upload_xlsx,
)

_inp = Inputs(
    dec_dist=dec_dist,
    dec_tx=dec_tx,
    existing_customers=existing_customers,
    rdm_total_mwh=RDM_TOTAL_MWH,
    residential_mwh=residential_mwh,
    tac_total_kw=TAC_TOTAL_KW,
    tac_res_kw=TAC_RES_KW,
)
_wb = build_workbook(_inp)
_xlsx_path = Path("../cache") / DRIVE_NAME
_wb.save(_xlsx_path)
_link = upload_xlsx(_xlsx_path, DRIVE_FOLDER_ID, DRIVE_NAME)
_xlsx_path.unlink()
print(f"Uploaded {DRIVE_NAME}: {_link}")
```

## RDM and TAC impact of Rate HP on non-residential classes

### Existing-customer shortfall

If all `{python} f"{existing_customers:,}"` existing heat pump customers are auto-enrolled in Rate HP in Year 1, the Company would collect `{python} f"${annual_dist_shortfall:,.0f}"` less in annual distribution revenue and `{python} f"${annual_tx_shortfall:,.0f}"` less in transmission revenue — a total of `{python} f"${annual_total_shortfall:,.0f}"` per year.

Under the Company's company-wide RDM (flat ¢/kWh across all classes), approximately `{python} f"{nonres_kwh_share:.1%}"` of the distribution shortfall — `{python} f"${nonres_dist_shortfall:,.0f}"` — would fall on non-residential classes. Under the TAC (allocated by demand at the 12 monthly system peaks), approximately `{python} f"{nonres_demand_share:.1%}"` of the transmission shortfall — `{python} f"${nonres_tx_shortfall:,.0f}"` — would fall on non-residential classes.

The combined non-residential impact is `{python} f"${nonres_total_shortfall:,.0f}"` per year.

The per-kWh RDM adjustment attributable to this shortfall is `{python} f"{rdm_impact_per_kwh * 100:.5f}"` ¢/kWh.
